QuestInfo.name: Admin Fool's Day
QuestInfo.0: #bApril Fool's#k is the day of pranks. All bets are off, and, of course, Cassandra isn't going to miss the chance to get her prank on! She's got a plan to play a joke on the ever-polite #bMaple Admin#k.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra is fed up with how polite the Maple Admin behaves. She wants to take advantage of April Fool's Day to get the Maple Admin all riled up.\nShe asked you to collect a #b#t4032641##k from blue or purple monsters. Cassandra won't settle for just one cookie... she wants a big prank! Get #b10#k to really knock the #bMaple Admin#k's socks off!\r\n#bRepeatable#k

0.0: Finally this day has come! Finally I will get my reven-- Oh, hey! It's totally not April Fool's Day today. Fooled you! It so IS! Hahahaha! I love April Fool's SO MUCH! I've been hatching a scheme since last year to make that polite #bMaple Admin#k lose her marbles! Come on, you have to help me! Help me prank the #bMaple Admin#k!!

yes.0: All right! I know JUST the thing! Have you heard of the #b#t4032641##k? Blue and purple monsters drop them. They look delicious, but if you actually EAT them? MWAHAHAHAHA! It's totally hilarious, I promise!\nAren't you curious to see what a #b#t4032641##k would do to a person? Go get #b10#k and give them to the #bMaple Admin#k. You'll see how funny it is!\n#i4032641# #t4032641#

no.0: Are you telling me you don't have the guts?! B-but it's April Fool's! You're allowed to prank people today! They can't get mad! Don't be such a stick in the mud!
